profile.name: Kevinas Ramoska
profile.headline: Full-stack engineer building reliable .NET business applications, automated tests, and secure user experiences.
profile.summary: At BWG Foods, I work across C#, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, authentication, and delivery pipelines. I also bring Java Spring Boot, React, Kafka, and PostgreSQL experience from General Motors and my own full-stack projects.
profile.availability: I am always happy to connect with engineers, product teams, and people building useful software.
profile.metaDescription: Kevinas Ramoska, Junior Full Stack Engineer at BWG Foods UC in Ireland. Explore C#/.NET, Java and React projects, case studies and technical writing.

experiences.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
highlights: Develop and maintain ShopLinkPOS retailer and administration applications with C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, Razor, and SQL Server.
Build Playwright for .NET end-to-end tests and xUnit unit tests, backed by Azure DevOps pull-request validation and CI pipelines.
Improve single sign-on, permission-aware navigation, authentication, and production workflows while partnering with QA to validate fixes.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
highlights: Delivered ShopLinkPOS features for event registration, document management, and retailer news and content publishing.
Upgraded a cross-platform .NET MAUI application from .NET 8 to .NET 10 for Android and iOS.
Contributed to Just Eat Q-commerce integration, consent-management migration, analytics changes, database updates, and UAT fixes.

experiences.title: Software Engineer Intern / Part-Time
highlights: Engineered Java Spring Boot REST and data-sync functionality using PostgreSQL, JPA/Hibernate, and external API integrations.
Implemented and debugged Kafka producer and consumer workflows, message handling, failure scenarios, and service tests.
Created React and JavaScript screens with Ant Design and Azure AD/MSAL authentication for an internal application.

about: I develop and maintain retailer and administration applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, Razor, and SQL Server. My work spans product features, authentication, automated testing, production fixes, and CI/CD.

Before joining BWG full-time, I completed a full-stack internship there and worked with Java Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, and Kafka at General Motors. Those roles taught me to move comfortably between interfaces, services, data, testing, and delivery workflows.
